deposits: terrain-specific declared geological candidates; no random mineral draw
initial_generator: BASE P070 in one fully embodied S1 plant; consumes actual coal/water and wages
power_buffer_rule: declared one-time initial endowment, thirty coal/water supplies fifteen full-load cycles; operating purchases require actual RU and local supply
resident_buy_limit_ru: 10*w_cat; local stock only; food, consumer_goods, medicine, water order
mineral_sale_cap: one G1 cycle output per site, less actual twenty-cycle self-use reserve
partner_proposal: city_state_treaty registers a candidate; funded terms commit only at four-cycle selection
resource_jv: one deterministic city mine; twenty percent of full G1 original materials and 200 RU, escrowed at proposal; prior direct shares survive expiry
protection: protect/threat inputs from actual surviving ground and sea units in city or adjacent regions
city_population: existing population.grow formula with actual city basket and housing health; no population cap
